userListDesc: Open detail to edit role, password, package, overrides
pkgListDesc: Edit quotas; delete blocked while subscribers remain
createUserDesc: Password min 8 chars; edit role and permissions in detail later
createPkgDesc: Quota template; bind to users later
impersonateDesc: Your current session will be replaced (~2 hours).
deletePkgDesc: Delete is refused while users still use this package.
hostUsageHint: Machine-wide (host) totals, not hard per-user isolation
opsCheck1: Give Admin only to people who need privilege; use Operator day-to-day.
opsCheck2: Save after editing Permissions; one-click restore returns factory defaults.
opsCheck3: Do not delete packages with subscribers; unassign first.
opsCheck4: Backup restore is destructive—Admin by default; confirm before granting to Operator.
detailDesc: Account, access preview, and advanced overrides
rolePickHint: Pick the right job role; Admin stays fully open
activeHint: Active: can sign in and work
accessHint: Effective capabilities from role policy (readable labels)
overridesHint: Affects this user only; role defaults stay unchanged
adminNoOverrides: Admin users are always fully open; personal revokes are not applied.
grantsHint: Extra capabilities beyond the role pack
revokesHint: Turn off inherited capabilities (not for Admin)

roleDesc.admin: Full control: users, permissions, destructive ops. Always full-open.
roleDesc.operator: Day-to-day ops: services, updates, DNS/SSL, sites.
roleDesc.viewer: Read-only: status, logs, lists — no changes.
roleDesc.agent: Automation agent: low-risk writes with scope limits.

securityClearConfirm: Type the username to confirm clearing 2FA
securitySelfNote: To set up your own 2FA, open Security → My security.
cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete the signed-in account
cannotModifySelf: You cannot suspend or demote the signed-in account
cannotDemoteLastAdmin: Cannot suspend or demote the last admin
lockSelfHint: This is the signed-in account. Delete, suspend, and role change are blocked to prevent lock-out.
lockLastAdminHint: This is the last admin. Delete, suspend, and demotion are blocked.
demoteAdminDesc: This user will lose full admin access. Confirm only if another admin remains.
quotaNonNeg: Counts and quotas cannot be negative.
diskQuotaHint: Presets are GiB; custom box is MiB.
